author: Harsha Nandhan Reddy Gajulapalli
tests: Should set the right owner
Should have correct name and symbol
Should start with zero supply
Should mint tokens when sending ETH
Should update reserve balance on mint
Should emit TokensMinted event
Should revert when sending zero ETH
Should allow multiple users to mint
Should burn tokens and return ETH
Should emit TokensBurned event
Should revert when burning more than balance
Should revert when burning zero
Should allow owner to distribute dividends
Should track total dividends distributed
Should calculate withdrawable dividends correctly
Should split dividends proportionally
Should allow users to withdraw dividends
Should revert when no dividends to withdraw
Should not give dividends to new minters for past distributions
Should revert if non-owner tries to distribute
Should transfer dividend rights with tokens
Should allow staking tokens
Should emit Staked event
Should allow unstaking
Should revert staking with insufficient balance
Should revert unstaking with nothing staked
Should return correct account info
Should return correct contract stats
Should handle very small mint amounts
Should handle multiple dividend distributions
Should allow partial dividend withdrawals
Should be protected against reentrancy on burn
Should be protected against reentrancy on dividend withdrawal
note: No public-network deploy in this run. No private key was used. One assertion was corrected: staked tokens do not keep holder dividends.
